For the third time in just a few days, Ukraine has targeted the Kerch Bridge, the critical link connecting mainland Russia to Crimea.
But why is this bridge so important?
Built after Russia's annexation of Crimea, the Kerch Bridge serves as both a major civilian connection and a vital military logistics route for Russian forces operating in southern Ukraine. It has also become one of the most powerful symbols of Russia's control over Crimea.
Thank you for watching our video!
